en: Colorized historic postcard view of a small town square or courtyard. In the foreground is a landscaped garden with paths, low fences, shrubs, and trees. A stone war memorial obelisk with a round medallion portrait and stacked cannonballs on top stands prominently. Behind it is an arched gatehouse with a clock and a tower with a bulbous spire, forming the entrance to a larger complex or castle. Residential buildings with green-tiled and red-tiled roofs frame the scene on the left and right. The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century German town.
